prompt: create a learning program for someone with little engineering background to get into AI
response: For someone with little engineering background, start with online courses that focus on the basics of AI, such as Andrew Ng's Machine Learning course on Coursera. This will provide a strong foundation in the mathematical and statistical concepts underlying AI. Once comfortable, move on to more advanced topics like deep learning using TensorFlow or PyTorch. Engaging in practical projects and experimenting with open-source tools will accelerate learning. Attend workshops and meetups to network with professionals and gain practical experience.
